name: Gods Name
overview: The name of God is sacred and powerful, as Scripture commands believers not to take it in vain, warning of the serious consequences for doing so (Exodus 20:7). It is described as a strong tower where the righteous find safety, emphasizing God's protection and refuge (Proverbs 18:10). Jesus taught His followers to honor God's name in prayer, underscoring its holiness and reverence (Matthew 6:9). Ultimately, salvation is found exclusively through the name of the Lord, highlighting its unique and essential role in the believer's life (Acts 4:12).
